decision.recommended_strategy: Hybrid clean-room composition; do not fork one repository wholesale
decision.license_note: ARS is CC BY-NC 4.0; use concepts only in a clean-room reimplementation unless commercial permission is obtained.

architecture_layers: Independent review and final integrity gates
Persistent provenance, observability and continuous learning

phases.name: Legal, security and repository hygiene
phases.gate: No live secrets; provenance of every imported component known; ARS text/code not copied into commercial tree.

phases.name: Canonical schemas and run state
phases.gate: Round-trip validation, migrations and fixture tests pass.

phases.name: Deterministic orchestrator
phases.gate: Synthetic DAG suite proves dependency, concurrency, retry and recovery behavior.

phases.name: Retrieval and corpus subsystem
phases.gate: Retrieval benchmark beats naive web-search baseline on recall and source diversity.

phases.name: Source and citation trust chain
phases.gate: Fabricated, mismatched and manipulated citations are detected in seeded-defect tests.

phases.name: Claim-evidence graph
phases.gate: Every material report claim resolves to exact evidence spans and a standing verdict.

phases.name: Falsification and contradiction swarm
phases.gate: Seeded contradictions and hard negatives are surfaced with reproducible evidence.

phases.name: Analysis and reproducible computation
phases.gate: All quantitative claims can be recomputed from registered inputs.

phases.name: Synthesis and report pipeline
phases.gate: Report passes coverage, entailment, contradiction, style and integrity checks.

phases.name: ARA-style persistent research artifact
phases.gate: Cross-layer references are complete and no inferred history is presented as observed.

phases.name: Hooks, security and hardening
phases.gate: Red-team suite cannot bypass path, credential, evidence or completion controls.

phases.name: Evaluation harness
phases.gate: All release thresholds pass or regressions require explicit tracked acknowledgement.

phases.name: Optimization and release
phases.gate: Quality targets met at defined latency and cost ceilings.
